summary.en: A passenger vehicle fell into a ravine in Torghar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, killing eight and injuring seven. A drug smuggler was killed in a CCD encounter in Jhang. China’s space program will send a Pakistani pilot as its first foreign astronaut, and more than 2,300 Indian Sikh pilgrims arrived in Pakistan for Guru Nanak’s birthday. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: En personbil falt ned i en ravine i Torghar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, og drepte åtte og såret sju. En narkotikasmugler ble drept i et CCD-oppgjør i Jhang. Kinas romprogram vil sende en pakistansk pilot som sin første utenlandske astronaut, og mer enn 2 300 indiske sikh-pilgrimer ankom Pakistan for Guru Nanaks fødselsdag. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
